name: life-atlas
description: Privacy-conscious Google Timeline map dashboard built with Hono and Leaflet

scripts.check:legacy: node --check app.js && python3 -m py_compile server.py scripts/build_data.py scripts/build_public.py scripts/prepare_sample_data.py scripts/validate_app.py scripts/test_server_auth.py && python3 scripts/validate_app.py && python3 scripts/test_server_auth.py
scripts.check: npm run build:public && npm run types:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:worker && npm run check:legacy
scripts.check:sample: npm run prepare:sample && npm run check
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:public && wrangler dev --local --var ENVIRONMENT:development
